senses.gloss:
m. (-दः)
Identity, absence of difference or distinction.
mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Alike, identical.
E.
अ neg. भेद distinction.

n. (-द्यं)
A diamond.
mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
1 Hard, solid, not to be broken or divided.
2 Not to be pierced, indivisible.
3 Impenetrable.
E.
अ neg. and भेद्य to be broken.

f. (-ता)
1 Indivisibility.
2 Impenetrability.
3 Inseparability.
E.
तल् added to the last, also with त्व, अभेद्यत्वं.

f. (-री)
One of the Rāgiṇīs or modes of music, femininely personified.
E.
आङ्, भेरी a drum.
